terms.gloss: stretch out / pull back the legs
terms.comment: Our description of what the legs do on a swing: stretch them out, pull them back. Traupman has only oscillāre, to swing (pp. 53, 389); no reference work has a word for pumping.

sources: Descriptions and prompts labelled as ours are composed for family conversation. Recorded vocabulary does not imply universal technical standardization.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 53, 389.
